intro.text: There are actually two types of them, made either from Small Obsidian Jar or Obsidian Jar. Jars drops off random mobs in Inner Sanctum. Only thing needed to complete the process is Advanced Hacker Tool, available from Devices Terminal.

steps.text: Note: Both headgears are leveling items (right-click on them to upgrade them), Watchman's between QL 140 and 180, Chief's between QL 180 and 200. Both are also title locked, Watchman's at title 4 to 5 and Chief's at title 5
